text:
Lina Chen: Quick heads-up — I'm pulling together a week-of-launch playbook that bundles the webinar, benchmark narrative, and inbound routing for the Private Deploy / SLAs launch. Sharing a working doc here: https://tiny.redwood/launch-playbook-draft :eyes:
Marco Ruiz: Sending the doc now, thanks. Can we land the benchmark narrative (latency/cost tradeoffs) + a short launch post for the blog? Need copy by EOD Wed.
Priya Patel: I'll draft the webinar title + description. Any preferred angle? security-first? cost savings?
Lina Chen: Priorities: 1) Credibility for enterprise buyers (SLA numbers, GovCloud/VPC notes) 2) A simple benchmark headline (e.g., "3–5x cost efficiency on typical chat workloads vs naive serving") 3) Clear CTA for Dedicated demos + gated SFDC form.
Evan Brooks: Engineering can provide perf numbers tomorrow morning. We have median P50/P95 token latency and cost-per-1M tokens for the three configs (hosted, dedicated small pool, private on-prem quantized).
Marco Ruiz: Perfect. Priya, aim for a webinar hook that ties the benchmark into a migration decision: "How we cut inference cost by X while keeping P95 latency under Y". Also include a 15-min live demo of the Console.
Priya Patel: Draft headline options: 
- "Serving LLMs at Enterprise Scale: Cost, SLAs, and Migration Paths"
- "Cut Inference Cost Without Sacrificing SLA"
Which one resonates?
Lina Chen: I like the second for social. First is better for the registration page.
Marco Ruiz: Routing: Once people register, we need an auto-assignment in HubSpot by company size + compliance tag. Small < $1M ARR -> SDR nurture, Mid-market -> AE, Enterprise + compliance -> Solutions Eng + AE. Can someone paste the HubSpot workflow?
Priya Patel: Here's the minimal routing rule we'll ship in the playbook:

```
if registration.company_size == "Enterprise" or registration.tags contains "compliance" then
  assign -> "AE-Team" + add_task("SE follow-up")
elif registration.company_size == "Mid" then
  assign -> "Mid-Market-AE"
else
  assign -> "SDR-Nurture"
end
```

We also add a hidden field for "deployment_interest" so we can route Dedicated vs Private leads.
Evan Brooks: For the benchmark narrative, engineering numbers: P50 token latency: 18ms (Hosted), 12ms (Dedicated small pool), 22ms (Private quantized). P95: 120ms / 65ms / 140ms respectively. Cost per 1M tokens: $5 hosted / $2.1 dedicated / $0.9 private (amortized infra). I'll attach the CSV to the doc.
Lina Chen: Good — we'll craft an honest narrative: "tradeoffs: best latency+predictability on Dedicated, best unit cost on Private but slightly higher tail latency unless configured for low-latency instance sizes". Keep it simple for marketing.
Marco Ruiz: Webinar logistics: 45 min total; 25 min talk (benchmarks + migration playbook), 10 min demo, 10 min Q&A. Host: Priya, Panel: Evan + Lina. Goal: generate qualified demo requests.
Priya Patel: Landing page draft: short bullets, one benchmark chart, CTA "Request a Dedicated Demo" -> SFDC form with: email, company, title, company_size, deployment_interest, compliance_requirements.
Lina Chen: For the launch post (social + blog blurb), propose: 1 short tweet thread with benchmark headline, 1 LinkedIn long post, 1 blog post with methodology appendix and CSV. Evan — make sure the methodology section explains input prompts, model family, sequence length distribution.
Evan Brooks: Will do. Also adding a short reproducibility snippet for our eval harness: 
```
python eval_harness.py --model redwood-dedicated-v1 --seq-dist chat-50-200 --tokens 100000
```
Marco Ruiz: MarketingBot — schedule the first promo post for 2 days before webinar, reminder 1 day before, and final reminder 1 hour before.
MarketingBot: Scheduled posts: promo @ 1719995600, reminder @ 1719999200, final reminder @ 1719991400. Links will be populated after final assets are uploaded. :robot_face:
Priya Patel: Action items:
- Evan: perf CSV + methodology by tomorrow 10am
- Marco: SFDC form + HubSpot workflow by EOD
- Lina: benchmark headline + landing page copy by Wed EOD
- Priya: webinar page + registration flow by Wed EOD

Anyone object to those timelines?
Marco Ruiz: All good from my side.
Evan Brooks: Fine, ping me if the numbers need rerun.
Lina Chen: I'll pull together the social text and a 1-pager handout for AEs once assets are final.
Priya Patel: I'll slot the webinar in Calendly and send the registration link here when ready.
Lina Chen: Thanks team — let's try to keep the messaging transparent about tradeoffs. This will help with inbound quality and reduce follow-up churn. :seedling:
Marco Ruiz: Agreed. Closing the loop after the draft run-through tomorrow 11am.
MarketingBot: Reminder: draft assets due in /marketing-assets/launch-playbook by 1719993000.
Lina Chen: Great, that's helpful. I'll post the final copy in the doc and DM AEs once the form fields are locked. :rocket:
